title: Smart charging without rebound peaks: Wholesale price feedback limits distribution grid peaks from price-responsive electric vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2610.34133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Studies on price-optimized EV charging consistently find that the common price signal synchronizes charging of the entire fleet of cars in the cheapest hours and creates new "rebound" load peaks in low-voltage grids. Almost all of these studies treat wholesale prices as exogenous, i.e., unaffected by the shifting EV load. This paper argues that this assumption overstates the problem: charging in low-price hours raises the wholesale price in those hours, which spreads charging across hours in equilibrium. I simulate price-optimized charging under real-time prices calibrated to German 2025 data. Even when adjusting for the increase in electricity demand, the coincident import peak of the local grid rises by 260%. After adding a model of equilibrium wholesale prices that takes the price-quantity feedback into account, the increase is reduced to a mere 5%. translated_title: 无回弹峰值的智能充电：批发价格反馈限制了价格响应型电动汽车造成的配电网峰值
translated_abstract: 关于价格优化的电动汽车充电的研究一致发现，常见的价格信号会导致整个车队在最便宜的时段同步充电，从而在低压电网中产生新的“回弹”负荷峰值。几乎所有这些研究都将批发价格视为外生变量，即不受转移的电动汽车负荷的影响。本文认为这一假设夸大了问题的严重性：在低价时段充电会抬高这些时段的批发价格，在均衡状态下这将使充电分散到不同时段。我基于德国2025年数据校准的实时价格，模拟了价格优化的充电行为。即使对电力需求的增加进行调整，当地电网的同步进口峰值仍上升260%。在加入考虑价格-数量反馈的均衡批发价格模型后，这一增幅降至仅5%。在允许车网互动（V2G）的情况下，出口峰值分别上升115%和下降6%。
tldr: 本文指出，传统研究将批发价格视为外生变量从而夸大了电动汽车“回弹峰值”问题，在考虑批发价格与充电负荷之间的均衡反馈后，配电网同步峰值增幅可从260%大幅降至5%。
